test: Rink twenty six announcer check. If you can hear this, the announcer is ready. Let's play hockey!
intro: Welcome to the arena. Your home team is ready. The visitors are ready. Fans, make some noise. It's hockey time!
goal: Goal! What a finish! The puck is in the net. Listen to this crowd!
save: A big save! The goalie shuts the door.
drop: The puck is down. Here we go!
draw: A clean faceoff win. Time to build the attack.
penalty: Interference. A thirty second minor penalty. The power play is coming up.
whistle: The whistle stops play. Get ready for the next faceoff.
period: That is the end of the period. Check the scoreboard. We will be back for more hockey.
final: That is the final horn. What a game. Thank you, fans!
line: Fresh legs coming over the boards. A new line is on the ice.
freeze: Covered by the goalie. A defensive zone faceoff.
onetimer: A one timer off the pass!
chant: Let's go! Let's go! Let's go!
crew: Ice crew, you are up. Resurface the ice, then park in the service bay.
tutorial-0: Welcome to the Gretzky themed hockey school. This is an unofficial fan tutorial with a computer narrator. Start with your skates. Use your movement controls, look for open ice, and release sprint before a sharp turn.
tutorial-1: Great passing starts before you receive the puck. Face an open teammate, pass, and move into space. Use the passing challenge to practice ten completions.
tutorial-2: Do not rush every shot. Hold the shot button for power, then release. Aim toward an open corner. Change between wrist, snap and slap shots, and try a one timer when a pass arrives.
tutorial-3: In goal, position comes first. Stay square to the puck. Use butterfly for low shots, glove for high shots, and a slide to move across the crease. Cover a loose puck to stop play.
tutorial-4: Build your own team in the club builder. Open free player packs, collect players from every team in the synced league, and assign them to your starting lineup. Save your club, then choose play this team.
tutorial-5: You are ready to take the ice. Start on rookie difficulty, practice one skill at a time, and use the controls menu whenever you need a different keyboard or mouse layout. Have fun out there!
